<title level="1" right="Creature Family">[Elemental, Metal](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=343)</title>

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 153

Metal elementals can manifest in a wide variety of different forms, from shapeless amalgams of different metals to humanoid and beast-like monstrosities.

<title level="2">Members</title>
[Abysium Horror](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2652) (Creature 10), [Ferrous Butterfly](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2643) (Creature 1), [Kinzaruk](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2646) (Creature 3), [Living Lodestone](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2649) (Creature 6), [Melomach](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2654) (Creature 13), [Mercurial](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2645) (Creature 2), [Nanoshard Swarm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2651) (Creature 9), [Oregorger](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2653) (Creature 11), [Quickiron Plasm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2647) (Creature 4), [Rust Scarab](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2648) (Creature 5), [Skymetal Striker](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2650) (Creature 7)

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_2_AdditionalLore.png">Metal Forms</title>

Though metal elementals are made almost entirely of metal, most are composed of layers of different metals in tiny fragments, as complex as a body of flesh or plant matter. Many of these metals are rusted or decayed from the natural, slow entropy of the [Plane of Metal](/Planes.aspx?ID=24).
</aside>

<title level="2" right="Creature Family Group">Elemental</title>

**Related Families**
[Elemental, Air](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=41), [Elemental, Air](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=408), [Elemental, Earth](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=42), [Elemental, Earth](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=409), [Elemental, Fire](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=43), [Elemental, Fire](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=410), [Elemental, Mephit](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=44), [Elemental, Scamp](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=411), [Elemental, Water](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=45), [Elemental, Water](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=412), [Elemental, Wisp](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=232), [Elemental, Wood](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=345)
